entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The faint murmur of the crowd outsi..."
entries.dialogueText: The faint murmur of the crowd outside seeped into Palas Rezna's second-floor sitting room, its restlessness contrasting with the stillness inside.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Romus, as you stand before your su..."
entries.dialogueText: "Romus, as you stand before your subjects today, remember that history is written by the victors."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We must not falter, lest ATO engul..."
entries.dialogueText: "We must not falter, lest ATO engulf Southern Merkopa in its ever-expanding grasp."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The walls of this solemn chamber we..."
entries.dialogueText: The walls of this solemn chamber were adorned with the dignified portraits of my ancestors – King Valero, Queen Lyza, and the long lineage of House Toras stretching back to its inception.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo peered out towards the balcony..."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo peered out towards the balcony, then turned to face me, his expression as solemn as I'd ever seen it.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The international community and th..."
entries.dialogueText: "The international community and the AN are against us. The world order they are creating is a farce!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""They tried to attack me in Zille b..."
entries.dialogueText: "They tried to attack me in Zille but failed. Now, a new threat rises from the south. We will fight our enemies on every front, and we will win."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Our future hangs in the balance. I..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our future hangs in the balance. If we do not confront the threat at our southern border now, it will consume us."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""In the past, I sought to bridge ou..."
entries.dialogueText: "In the past, I sought to bridge our differences, engaging in earnest diplomacy with the Duke of Pales. Look at where that got us."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Duke Reinhart's broken promises an..."
entries.dialogueText: "Duke Reinhart's broken promises and lack of honor are a stark betrayal of our trust and the principles of this kingdom."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Princess Vina journeyed to Pales i..."
entries.dialogueText: "Princess Vina journeyed to Pales in the spirit of diplomacy. By keeping her there, Duke Reinhart abused our trust."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The very honor of our kingdom has..."
entries.dialogueText: "The very honor of our kingdom has been placed at stake. Our royal house attacked, our successor stolen from us."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The wrongful detainment of Vina is..."
entries.dialogueText: "The wrongful detainment of Vina is a test of our resolve, sent by divine providence. Together, we will overcome it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""With all my might and righteousnes..."
entries.dialogueText: "With all my might and righteousness, I promise to return the princess and show our enemies our true strength."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That Pales would do this to a true..."
entries.dialogueText: "That Pales would do this to a true daughter of Rizia reflects their desperation and dishonor."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""In stark contrast to their barbari..."
entries.dialogueText: "In stark contrast to their barbarity, we shall demonstrate our civility and honor. We shall not stoop to their level."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The future of Rizia and its people..."
entries.dialogueText: "The future of Rizia and its people depends on reliable energy sources that feed our industry and growth."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""For a safe and secure Rizia, we em..."
entries.dialogueText: "For a safe and secure Rizia, we embark on this path to reclaim what destiny has decreed as ours."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Whether in Pales or Zille, we will..."
entries.dialogueText: "Whether in Pales or Zille, we will stop at nothing to safeguard what our God has bestowed upon us."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""In a surprising twist of fate, Val..."
entries.dialogueText: "In a surprising twist of fate, Valgsland has shown greater integrity than many who claimed to share our values."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Derdia stood with us as a powerful..."
entries.dialogueText: "Derdia stood with us as a powerful regional friend also facing international pressure for its way of life."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We found support from our neighbor..."
entries.dialogueText: "We found support from our neighbors in Morella, who refused to let political differences get in the way of justice."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Our valiant sons and daughters hav..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our valiant sons and daughters have stood resolute, safeguarding our heritage and cultural treasures from foreign encroachment."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""God was with us that day as we exp..."
entries.dialogueText: "God was with us that day as we expelled the enemy from our precious land and paleaccis."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I solemnly vow to avenge these vil..."
entries.dialogueText: "I solemnly vow to avenge these vile actions. We will counter every blow, return every volley and strike fear into the heart of the Palesians."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""There are those who accuse me of m..."
entries.dialogueText: "There are those who accuse me of merely following in the footsteps of my father. But I am determined to carve my own path as king."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The legacy of King Valero, my fath..."
entries.dialogueText: "The legacy of King Valero, my father, will be rectified under my reign, correcting the course of history."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I fight this war in honor of the l..."
entries.dialogueText: "I fight this war in honor of the legacy of His Majesty King Valero. Together, we can fulfill his dream of a reunited Rizia."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Chosen by divine will, the message..."
entries.dialogueText: "Chosen by divine will, the message is clear: this war is destined for our triumph."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The reasons for this war should be..."
entries.dialogueText: "The reasons for this war should be self-evident. I do not need to waste my time justifying them to you."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Ancient texts prophesy the conques..."
entries.dialogueText: "Ancient texts prophesy the conquest of Pales by Rizia. We will win this war because it is our divine destiny."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This war is about our way of life...."
entries.dialogueText: "This war is about our way of life. Pales is threatening our people as well as our principles."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Visions have come to me, foretelli..."
entries.dialogueText: "Visions have come to me, foretelling conflict; a divine sign that our path is righteous."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Today, we stand united, not in cel..."
entries.dialogueText: "Today, we stand united, not in celebration, but in solemn duty."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I stepped out onto the balcony and..."
entries.dialogueText: I stepped out onto the balcony and took in the immense scene unfolding before me. A sea of people stretched across the palace gardens and the streets beyond them, fading far into the distance.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As I approached the microphone, sil..."
entries.dialogueText: As I approached the microphone, silence spread throughout the mass. Their attention focused entirely on me.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""As they have done in the past, our..."
entries.dialogueText: "As they have done in the past, our friends in Wehlen came through for us on the global stage."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Rizia was struck first by Pales, o..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rizia was struck first by Pales, our long-standing adversary, reigniting a conflict that has been simmering for years."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We sent our navy to Aureus because..."
entries.dialogueText: "We sent our navy to Aureus because we feared the Palesians would disrespect our claim to the field. With their attack, they proved us right."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""They crossed our border and attack..."
entries.dialogueText: "They crossed our border and attacked land that belonged to Rizia for centuries. They escalated this conflict."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Our peaceful nation now faces war,..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our peaceful nation now faces war, imposed by our southern neighbor."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""As we prepare to engage with Pales..."
entries.dialogueText: "As we prepare to engage with Pales once again, we must let our faith and unity be our guiding light."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""My fellow Rizians.""
entries.dialogueText: "My fellow Rizians."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Subjects of Rizia.""
entries.dialogueText: "Subjects of Rizia."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I want each and every one of you t..."
entries.dialogueText: "I want each and every one of you to listen to what your King has to say."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I appear before you today with a g..."
entries.dialogueText: "I appear before you today with a grave message."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Followers of the Almighty and the..."
entries.dialogueText: "Followers of the Almighty and the one."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The next few months will be a chan..."
entries.dialogueText: "The next few months will be a chance for Rizia to prove its resilience."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The events that are about to occur..."
entries.dialogueText: "The events that are about to occur will test us, yet also define us."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""In our efforts for peace, we have..."
entries.dialogueText: "In our efforts for peace, we have reached out to Pales time and time again. Each time, we have been met with betrayal and aggression. Enough is enough."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Our borders, our sacred lands, wer..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our borders, our sacred lands, were violated. We stand not as aggressors, but as defenders of our home."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The unprovoked attack on our navy,..."
entries.dialogueText: "The unprovoked attack on our navy, the sinking of the RRN Valero, was a clear declaration of war. We have no choice but to respond in kind."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The abduction of Princess Vina, a..."
entries.dialogueText: "The abduction of Princess Vina, a symbol of our future, is an attack not just on the crown, but on every Rizian citizen."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Confronted with the Duke's escalat..."
entries.dialogueText: "Confronted with the Duke's escalating threats, our hand is forced; we rise now to shield the very heart of Rizia."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The treachery of Duke Axel Reinhar..."
entries.dialogueText: "The treachery of Duke Axel Reinhart compels us to act. It is our duty to protect our nation from his deceitful maneuvers."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The loss of RRN Valero -- named af..."
entries.dialogueText: "The loss of RRN Valero -- named after my father -- is a wound to our nation."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""In honoring the brave souls lost a..."
entries.dialogueText: "In honoring the brave souls lost at sea, we pledge to resist Palesian naval aggression while holding every life sacred."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""By keeping our heiress as a hostag..."
entries.dialogueText: "By keeping our heiress as a hostage, the Palesians have shown their flagrant disrespect for the Rizian royal family."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We will not rest until justice is..."
entries.dialogueText: "We will not rest until justice is served for the wrongful imprisonment of our future queen."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Under the watchful gaze of the wor..."
entries.dialogueText: "Under the watchful gaze of the world, we shall rise, showcasing the indomitable spirit that courses through Rizia's veins."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The unjust attack on our naval for..."
entries.dialogueText: "The unjust attack on our naval forces was a clear act of aggression by Pales against Rizia. One that demanded an aggressive response."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Pales' pre-emptive claim to Aureus..."
entries.dialogueText: "Pales' pre-emptive claim to Aureus and its subsequent border raid were two sides of the same coin of aggression."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The incursion on our lands by Pale..."
entries.dialogueText: "The incursion on our lands by Pales was an undeniable declaration of war against our sovereign nation."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Yielding full control of the Aureu..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yielding full control of the Aureus reserves was not an option. Our nation's future depends on these critical resources."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Our diplomatic clash over Aureus m..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our diplomatic clash over Aureus marks a prelude to the tensions we face today with Pales."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Our many international allies help..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our many international allies helped us secure a partial claim to Aureus. With their support, we will win the entire field."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""In the face of global injustice, w..."
entries.dialogueText: "In the face of global injustice, we stand firm in defending our rightful claim to Aureus."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Despite the AN ruling in favor of..."
entries.dialogueText: "Despite the AN ruling in favor of Pales, we stand here today, resolute in defending our nation against their encroachment."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Lespia has swayed the Alliance of..."
entries.dialogueText: "Lespia has swayed the Alliance of Nations against us. But today, we face Pales with the conviction of our cause."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Our enemies tried to tempt us with..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our enemies tried to tempt us with temporary gains. Yet we chose the path of self-reliance."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Ou refusal to be subjugated in the..."
entries.dialogueText: "Ou refusal to be subjugated in the Aureus deal reflects our broader stance against Palesian aggression."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Pales's violation of our historic..."
entries.dialogueText: "Pales's violation of our historic landmarks, following our purchase of the rights to Aureus, left us no choice but to act."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Pales attacked our very border, ho..."
entries.dialogueText: "Pales attacked our very border, hoping we would cede our legally purchased rights to Aureus. We refused to give in."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Our stance on Aureus, backed by th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our stance on Aureus, backed by the Royal Navy, was a clear signal that Rizia will stop at nothing to protect our maritime rights."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The Palesians dared to challenge u..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Palesians dared to challenge us at sea, encroaching upon our rights and attacking our brave sailors - an act of undeniable hostility."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Once we capture Pales, we will gai..."
entries.dialogueText: "Once we capture Pales, we will gain full control of Aureus and finally achieve energy autonomy."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I readied the notes I'd prepared ab..."
entries.dialogueText: I readied the notes I'd prepared about the gas field arbitration.
entries.menuText: Talk about the gas field arbitration.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "Tears welled in my eyes as I began..."
entries.dialogueText: Tears welled in my eyes as I began to speak about my daughter.
entries.menuText: Talk about Vina being taken hostage.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I decided to talk about the inciden..."
entries.dialogueText: I decided to talk about the incident that sparked the war.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I decided to talk about the naval i..."
entries.dialogueText: I decided to talk about the naval incident that occurred.
entries.menuText: Talk about the naval incident that occurred.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I flipped through my notes."
entries.dialogueText: I flipped through my notes.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""As Lespia's influence in Pales gro..."
entries.dialogueText: "As Lespia's influence in Pales grows, we find ourselves compelled to act, not just for Rizia, but for balance in our region."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The shadow of Lespia and the Arcas..."
entries.dialogueText: "The shadow of Lespia and the Arcasian Treaty Organization looms large over Pales. We wage this war to counter their encroaching influence."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We must shield our part of the con..."
entries.dialogueText: "We must shield our part of the continent against Lespia's expanding reach before it is too late."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We are fighting for nothing less t..."
entries.dialogueText: "We are fighting for nothing less than our kingdom's economic future."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Expanding our borders, securing re..."
entries.dialogueText: "Expanding our borders, securing resources – this war is a step towards a greater, more prosperous Rizia."

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I went on to talk about my convicti..."
entries.dialogueText: I went on to talk about my convictions.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It is a regrettable twist of the k..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is a regrettable twist of the knife that Wehlen, despite years of alliance, refrained from standing by us when it mattered most."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Morella's stance in the global for..."
entries.dialogueText: "Morella's stance in the global forum has been a letdown, straying far from the cameraderie we expected."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Our expectation was for Derdia to..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our expectation was for Derdia to empathize with our plight. Yet their stance left us disillusioned."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Our partial victory at the AN was..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our partial victory at the AN was bittersweet. We won the battle over Aureus, but the war has only just begun."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The Alliance of Nations ruled in o..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Alliance of Nations ruled in our favor. Yet accepting their resolution would mean accepting defeat."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Gaining partial rights to Aureus a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Gaining partial rights to Aureus at the AN was not enough. For the sake of Rizian energy independence, we must fight for more."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Despite our earnest efforts at arb..."
entries.dialogueText: "Despite our earnest efforts at arbitration, the AN's ruling against Rizia left our nation vulnerable, compelling us to act."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The AN's unfair ruling over the Au..."
entries.dialogueText: "The AN's unfair ruling over the Aureus field has forced our hand, to defend our territory against external biases."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Lespia and the AN have conspired t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Lespia and the AN have conspired to rob us of what is rightfully ours. In the face of such injustice, our only recourse is to stand up for Rizia."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The Palesians were not content to..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Palesians were not content to attack our sovereignty. They made this conflict personal by taking my daughter."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Vina's abduction is an attack on o..."
entries.dialogueText: "Vina's abduction is an attack on our royal heart. Our war is also a crusade to bring our princess home."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Guided by divine vision, this war..."
entries.dialogueText: "Guided by divine vision, this war is not just a political act, but a fulfillment of a higher, sacred duty."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This war is as much about honor as..."
entries.dialogueText: "This war is as much about honor as it is about strategic gain. It is up to me to complete my father's unfinished quest."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""While this war may seem like a def..."
entries.dialogueText: "While this war may seem like a defensive measure, it is also a path to our national as well as my personal glory."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Dear Rizian soldiers, pilots, and..."
entries.dialogueText: "Dear Rizian soldiers, pilots, and sailors, today you embark on a great, great conquest. A conquest that will end with the greatest triumph Rizia has ever seen."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Our troops are the guardians of ou..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our troops are the guardians of our kingdom, the brave hearts who stand at the forefront of this critical moment in our history."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Each one of you carries the spirit..."
entries.dialogueText: "Each one of you carries the spirit of Rizia into battle – a spirit unyielding, courageous, and proud."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""As you defend our borders, skies,..."
entries.dialogueText: "As you defend our borders, skies, and seas, know that you carry with you the hopes and prayers of every single Rizian."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""In you, the legacy of our forefath..."
entries.dialogueText: "In you, the legacy of our forefathers and foremothers lives on – a legacy of resilience, honor, and the will to protect our homeland."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Your actions in the coming weeks w..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your actions in the coming weeks will be remembered, your likenesses carved into stone, your names preserved throughout history."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""May your courage light the path to..."
entries.dialogueText: "May your courage light the path to victory, and may your steadfastness inspire generations to come."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""House Azaro, our warriors, shall l..."
entries.dialogueText: "House Azaro, our warriors, shall lead us into battle. General Taddeus and his daughter Lucita will not fail us."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We are supported by the esteemed A..."
entries.dialogueText: "We are supported by the esteemed Azaros of Cardesse-Montaklar, whose military prowess and strategic acumen inspires not only their home province but the whole kingdom."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""House Azaro will be the sword and..."
entries.dialogueText: "House Azaro will be the sword and shield of Rizia in these times of conflict."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""In this fateful hour, we are lucky..."
entries.dialogueText: "In this fateful hour, we are lucky to have House Sazon standing with us."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The members of House Sazon join ou..."
entries.dialogueText: "The members of House Sazon join our ranks, setting aside past differences for the greater good of Rizia."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""House Sazon of Brenas will be key..."
entries.dialogueText: "House Sazon of Brenas will be key allies in this fight, harnessing the knowledge and youthful energy of their province to outwit and outmaneuver the enemy."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I will remind the members of House..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will remind the members of House Sazon how lenient my family has been to them in the past. They will support us in this war or else."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Of course, I will be leading Rizia..."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course, I will be leading Rizia into battle with the entire Toras royal family by my side."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""My cousin Rico Toras, with his unb..."
entries.dialogueText: "My cousin Rico Toras, with his unbridled valor and loyalty, embodies the spirit of our house – a spirit that will lead us to victory."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I call upon my relatives in House..."
entries.dialogueText: "I call upon my relatives in House Toras, stewards of Valenqiris and the throne, to take up arms in defense of the ancient values and traditions that define our golden kingdom."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Noble houses of Rizia, your allegi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Noble houses of Rizia, your allegiance in this crucial hour fortifies the soul of our nation."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Each house, with its history and l..."
entries.dialogueText: "Each house, with its history and legacy, brings a unique strength to our collective endeavor – together, we will not be defeated."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""As the pillars of Rizian society,..."
entries.dialogueText: "As the pillars of Rizian society, your commitment and leadership are the beacons guiding us to victory."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""With two centuries on the throne b..."
entries.dialogueText: "With two centuries on the throne behind us, House Toras rises to meet this moment."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I addressed the noble houses."
entries.dialogueText: I addressed the noble houses.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""To the people of Rizia, the soul o..."
entries.dialogueText: "To the people of Rizia, the soul of our nation, now is the time to rise, to join the ranks of those who defend our land."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I look out at all of you, and I se..."
entries.dialogueText: "I look out at all of you, and I see the true power of this kingdom."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Each citizen's effort, whether on..."
entries.dialogueText: "Each citizen's effort, whether on the battlefield or at home, will make a difference in our victory."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I call upon the youth of Rizia to..."
entries.dialogueText: "I call upon the youth of Rizia to take up the mantle of defense. It is your turn to write your own chapter in our storied history."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Your enlistment, your support and..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your enlistment, your support and your sacrifices are the building blocks of a free, victorious, and prosperous Rizia."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Together, we are an unbreakable fo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Together, we are an unbreakable force; united, we will face this challenge and emerge as one."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""In every street and every home of..."
entries.dialogueText: "In every street and every home of Rizia, your determination fuels our nation's spirit against all odds."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""From the fields to the factories,..."
entries.dialogueText: "From the fields to the factories, your contributions fortify the very foundations upon which our kingdom stands."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""To the elders of Rizia, your wisdo..."
entries.dialogueText: "To the elders of Rizia, your wisdom and guidance in these turbulent times light our path forward."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Your collective will, the heartbea..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your collective will, the heartbeat of Rizia, resonates louder than the drums of war."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This is but the first step on a lo..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is but the first step on a long journey towards a grander Rizia, the likes of which the world has not seen since the days of Queen Lyza."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""As we stand on the brink of destin..."
entries.dialogueText: "As we stand on the brink of destiny, our collective resolve must not waver. For every challenge faced, Rizia stands taller, prouder."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""As we begin this difficult journey..."
entries.dialogueText: "As we begin this difficult journey, remember that every step you take is a stride towards our shared destiny."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This land of ours, with its rollin..."
entries.dialogueText: "This land of ours, with its rolling hills, fertile soil and ancient cities, calls for its children to protect its legacy. For Rizia, for our future!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""In these times of uncertainty, let..."
entries.dialogueText: "In these times of uncertainty, let our shared hopes bind us. Each act of courage, small or large, weaves a brighter tomorrow."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I didn't address the Azaros."
entries.dialogueText: I didn't address the Azaros.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I did not address the Sazons."
entries.dialogueText: I did not address the Sazons.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""House Toras, our royal lineage, st..."
entries.dialogueText: "House Toras, our royal lineage, stands as the unshakable pillar of Rizia, guiding our nation with wisdom and honor."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""To our esteemed paratroopers, your..."
entries.dialogueText: "To our esteemed paratroopers, your bravery and swiftness are the wings upon which our hopes soar."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Our stalwart mountaineers will bra..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our stalwart mountaineers will brave rugged terrain and harsh conditions to drive away the enemy."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Our mechanized forces, swift and r..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our mechanized forces, swift and relentless, are the driving force that propels us towards victory with unmatched speed and agility."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""To the mighty Rizian Fleet, master..."
entries.dialogueText: "To the mighty Rizian Fleet, masters of the seas, I expect you to blow Pales out of the water. Quite literally."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I ask our Lord God to watch over y..."
entries.dialogueText: "I ask our Lord God to watch over you in battle. May His mercy be your shield; His wrath your sword."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Soldiers of Rizia, you are the ham..."
entries.dialogueText: "Soldiers of Rizia, you are the hammer that will forge our victory. March forth with the might and conviction that our cause is just and true!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""When the historians write of the S..."
entries.dialogueText: "When the historians write of the Second Pales War, let it be written that it was you, the valiant protectors of Rizia, who turned the tide. Your deeds today will echo for generations."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Many of you will die. But know tha..."
entries.dialogueText: "Many of you will die. But know that you are making this sacrifice so that your children, and your children's children, may see a brighter tomorrow."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The deployed soldiers around the pa..."
entries.dialogueText: The deployed soldiers around the palace were listening attentively and saluted.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""To our foreign intelligence operat..."
entries.dialogueText: "To our foreign intelligence operatives, your unseen efforts will be crucial in making sure we are always one step ahead of Pales."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The Golden Guard, a formidable for..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Golden Guard, a formidable force of loyalty and might, shall defend Rizia as capably as they have defended their king."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I decided to address the Rizian Arm..."
entries.dialogueText: I decided to address the Rizian Armed Forces.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Our provincial divisions will serv..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our provincial divisions will serve as the vanguard of our army, leading the charge on behalf of their ancestral lands."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Each of you brings your own knowle..."
entries.dialogueText: "Each of you brings your own knowledge and skill set onto the battlefield. Cooperate with each other, and you will be unstoppable."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Together, our noble houses represe..."
entries.dialogueText: "Together, our noble houses represent the backbone of Rizia. With your help, we will stand tall against our adversaries."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I paused before moving on to the sp..."
entries.dialogueText: I paused before moving on to the speech's conclusion.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""In our language, culture, traditio..."
entries.dialogueText: "In our language, culture, tradition, lies our indomitable strength; together we confront our enemy, emerging more robust and united as a single nation."

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Surrounded by adversaries, our onl..."
entries.dialogueText: "Surrounded by adversaries, our only path to safety is to meet them on the battlefield."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Caught in the crossfire of CSP and..."
entries.dialogueText: "Caught in the crossfire of CSP and ATO's global strife, we stand firm against their encroachment. Rizia bows to no one."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Our preparations were not in vain...."
entries.dialogueText: "Our preparations were not in vain. They were the first steps toward an inevitable domination, a display of our unchallenged might."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We prepared for this conflict out..."
entries.dialogueText: "We prepared for this conflict out of necessity, not blood lust. We stand not as aggressors, but as guardians of our homeland's security."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Our readiness for war reflects our..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our readiness for war reflects our commitment to protect Rizia at all costs, even if it means striking first."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The crowd erupted in a tumultous ro..."
entries.dialogueText: The crowd erupted in a tumultous roar of approval. My subjects' excitement was palpable.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Waves of enthusiastic applause bega..."
entries.dialogueText: Waves of enthusiastic applause began to sweep through the crowd, their energy building as they hung on every word.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Murmurs of approval rippled through..."
entries.dialogueText: Murmurs of approval rippled through the crowd, my subjects' attention sharpening as my words resonated with them.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The crowd's silence permeated the a..."
entries.dialogueText: The crowd's silence permeated the air. They regarded me in calm anticipation of my next words.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The true colors of our fellow nati..."
entries.dialogueText: "The true colors of our fellow nations have now been revealed, unmasking a world of shallow promises and hidden agendas."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""No matter what they throw at us, w..."
entries.dialogueText: "No matter what they throw at us, we will stand tall. They will not infringe on our rights."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""When the AN refused to rule in our..."
entries.dialogueText: "When the AN refused to rule in our favor, we sent our navy as a sign that we would not back down."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I applaud our navy for taking swif..."
entries.dialogueText: "I applaud our navy for taking swift action to safeguard Rizian interests following the AN resolution."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Our partial victory at the AN was..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our partial victory at the AN was just the start. Our naval actions thereafter affirmed our determination."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I say to you that the Aureus rulin..."
entries.dialogueText: "I say to you that the Aureus ruling marks a new chapter in our relentless pursuit of justice and sovereignty."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This incident proved that a nation..."
entries.dialogueText: "This incident proved that a nation's sovereign borders cannot be determined by committee. Only God knows the truth."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""In the wake of these events, let i..."
entries.dialogueText: "In the wake of these events, let it be clear: no decision can sway our commitment to protect what is ours by history and by right."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The AN has spoken. Yet true verdic..."
entries.dialogueText: "The AN has spoken. Yet true verdicts are written not in chambers of debate, but in the hearts of a people united for their cause."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I am counting on our brave troops..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am counting on our brave troops to rescue Her Highness before the unspeakable happens."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We shall unleash the full fury of..."
entries.dialogueText: "We shall unleash the full fury of Rizia to reclaim our princess. No one will dare challenge our royal lineage again."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Though we mourn our losses, our sw..."
entries.dialogueText: "Though we mourn our losses, our swift victory against the Palesian forces reaffirms our unyielding defense of our territory."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Each Rizian life lost hardens our..."
entries.dialogueText: "Each Rizian life lost hardens our determination to win. We've repelled the Palesians, a mere prelude to the retribution they'll face."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Our brave soldiers triumphed, payi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our brave soldiers triumphed, paying a heavy price to push back the invaders. Their sacrifice fuels our fight for freedom."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""In the shadow of conflict and loss..."
entries.dialogueText: "In the shadow of conflict and loss, we emerged victorious, more determined than ever to secure a future free of the Palesian threat."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The Palesian soldiers lurking at o..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Palesian soldiers lurking at our borders will be given no quarter. Our response will be swift and decisive, a clear message to our foes."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We stand vigilant, ready to counte..."
entries.dialogueText: "We stand vigilant, ready to counter any Palesian aggression. Our military remains poised and ready."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Let those Palesian soldiers dare t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let those Palesian soldiers dare to tread on our land; they will meet the full might of Rizia's wrath, a lesson they won't forget."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Our borders are secure, watched by..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our borders are secure, watched by unblinking eyes. Any Palesian folly will be met with appropriate and calculated force."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""In a display of honor, we released..."
entries.dialogueText: "In a display of honor, we released the Palesian ships, prioritizing humanity over hostility even in the midst of conflict."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Our decision to free Palesian vess..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our decision to free Palesian vessels was a commitment to our values, even as we braved the storm to save the Valero."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""By aiding friend and foe alike at..."
entries.dialogueText: "By aiding friend and foe alike at sea, we demonstrated the strength of Rizian compassion and integrity."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Daring to rescue all, we extended..."
entries.dialogueText: "Daring to rescue all, we extended our efforts to Palesian sailors, embodying the true spirit of Rizian heroism."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Our frigates, amidst turmoil, soug..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our frigates, amidst turmoil, sought to save every soul, solidifying our legacy as a nation that values every life, whether friend or foe."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Our focus remained on the Valero,..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our focus remained on the Valero, a duty to our own above all, in a decisive moment of kinship and loyalty."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""While we sent aid to Palesian sail..."
entries.dialogueText: "While we sent aid to Palesian sailors, our heart was with the Valero, affirming our allegiance to those who bear our flag."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""In the chaos of battle, our aim wa..."
entries.dialogueText: "In the chaos of battle, our aim was clear: rescue the Valero first. We knew we would need our flagship for the battles to come."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Looking out at the crowd, I saw my..."
entries.dialogueText: Looking out at the crowd, I saw my citizens chanting, applauding and fervently waving flags.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Looking out at the crowd, I sensed..."
entries.dialogueText: Looking out at the crowd, I sensed an undercurrent of energy. Sporadic claps and shouts emerged, and Rizian flags began waving in the air.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Looking out at the crowd, I saw sub..."
entries.dialogueText: Looking out at the crowd, I saw subtle nods of encouragement among my supporters. My message was beginning to take root.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Looking out at the crowd, I saw pen..."
entries.dialogueText: Looking out at the crowd, I saw pensive expressions. My citizens were absorbing the gravity of my words with quiet introspection.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As I finished my speech, an explosi..."
entries.dialogueText: As I finished my speech, an explosive cheer erupted, the crowd's exuberance reaching its zenith, echoing triumphantly through Porte Drazon.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "In the final moments, fervent cheer..."
entries.dialogueText: In the final moments, fervent cheers and applause erupted, a potent mix of passion and resolve filling the air.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As the speech neared its end, the c..."
entries.dialogueText: As the speech neared its end, the crowd's energy bubbled over, their enthusiasm growing into a loud, rhythmic show of support.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "With my concluding words, a murmur..."
entries.dialogueText: With my concluding words, a murmur of agreement swelled into a chorus of assent, the first sparks of excitement igniting.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Rizia's fate teetered on the edge."
entries.dialogueText: Rizia's fate teetered on the edge.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "War, war was a never-changing subje..."
entries.dialogueText: War, war was a never-changing subject, repeating its age-old story.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I addressed the people."
entries.dialogueText: I addressed the people.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""In the throes of conflict, we capt..."
entries.dialogueText: "In the throes of conflict, we captured Palesian vessels, successfully protecting our Valero and its crew."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Our decision to capture enemy ship..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our decision to capture enemy ships, foregoing rescue, was a strategic move, dictated by the urgent need to protect our naval pride."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""With the Valero at stake, we opted..."
entries.dialogueText: "With the Valero at stake, we opted for capture over aid, a harsh but vital choice to maintain our maritime superiority."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Our Rizian Royal Navy stands as a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our Rizian Royal Navy stands as a pivotal force, ready to bolster our land units and sever the lifelines of enemy supplies."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""With the war already raging at sea..."
entries.dialogueText: "With the war already raging at sea, we brace for the inevitable clash on land. We must prepare for the many trials ahead."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Our future now rests in the capabl..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our future now rests in the capable hands of our valiant sailors, guardians of our destiny at sea."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Reinhart has forsaken his own peop..."
entries.dialogueText: "Reinhart has forsaken his own people's interests. He is nothing but a puppet to foreign powers. We will cut his strings."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""From Moridia's Gulf to Sudis, then..."
entries.dialogueText: "From Moridia's Gulf to Sudis, then across to the Antacean Sea, our lands will stand unshackled, our people resolutely free."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This incident proved that a nation..."
entries.dialogueText: "This incident proved that a nation's sovereign borders cannot be determined by committee. We in Rizia know the truth."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Vina is an innocent in all this. W..."
entries.dialogueText: "Vina is an innocent in all this. We cannot let the Palesians punish her simply for seeking peace."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""As if that weren't enough, Pales a..."
entries.dialogueText: "As if that weren't enough, Pales and their Lespian cronies had the temerity to accuse Duchess Lucita Azaro -- one of Rizia's most upstanding noblewomen -- of instigating the attack. We cannot stand for this."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I have always seen through the sel..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have always seen through the self-styled 'Duke' Axel Reinhart and his sham of a Grand Duchy. It is time for the facade to come crashing down."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Your valor and sacrifice are the b..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your valor and sacrifice are the bedrock upon which the future of our nation rests. We owe you an immeasurable debt of gratitude."

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
